nodes.long_description:
SoarState is mental training for paraglider pilots. Sit back in the pod, the wing flies itself, and all your attention goes on staying calm, sharp and in charge.

Launch from the Elfer above Neustift, work thermals up the ridge with other wings around you, and glide out over the valley to land. A calm narrator coaches you the whole way: where to look, how to breathe through the bumps, and how to turn nerves into focus.

• Breathing, paced by a soft drum and a breathing ring
• A five-step reset (Notice, Name, Breathe, Widen, Fly) you can take to the real hill
• Practise clear decisions: fly on, change the plan, or land
• Coaching that steps back as you improve
• A real valley: laser-scanned terrain, aerial imagery and thousands of trees
• Works offline once installed

FREE: Calm build-up (full and short) and Free flight.
FULL PACK (one purchase): Lively midday, Evening glass-off and Busy testing day.

Positive phrases: short, encouraging lines are shown openly in the sky in calm moments and spoken softly. You can read them, write your own, or switch them off.

SoarState is confidence and performance training. It isn’t flight instruction, therapy or medical treatment and makes no health claims. Use it seated at home, never while driving, walking or on the hill before you fly.

Terrain © Land Tirol (data.tirol.gv.at), imagery basemap.at, both CC BY 4.0.
